title: Title tag is very short
recommendation: Expand the title with clearer topic or brand context.

title: Missing meta description
recommendation: Add a plain-language meta description that summarizes the page value.

title: Missing canonical tag
recommendation: Add a canonical URL to reduce duplicate-content ambiguity.

title: Page has thin body content
recommendation: Add useful, specific content that answers the searcher's intent.

title: No internal links found
evidence: The page does not link to another same-site URL.
recommendation: Add relevant internal links to related pages or conversion paths.

title: No structured data detected
evidence: No JSON-LD or microdata blocks were found.
recommendation: Add relevant structured data when it helps describe the entity, service, article, or product.
